doc: Import edges allowed despite the direction table (use-doc §2, context/foundry/addon-blueprint.md). Each entry: {"from": "a.mjs", "to": "b.mjs", "why": "…"}. Every entry is a debt; the target is a ctx.exposed accessor (guide §2.3).

allow.why: taggedKind / forgetRoll: the runner's tag for the roll in flight classifies the swing; it is only live while rollAttack runs, so it is read synchronously
expectRoll / forgetRoll: the Reaction slot announces its attack roll as a reaction to the runner's tag table
running(): Esc and the cancelled-card tidy leave a Full Attack's own windows to it
registerTargetPicker: the HUD hands the runner Argon's target picker for a Retarget
running() / abortFor(): a turn change or a shape change stops a running sequence
runSwings / runFollowUp / running: what Full Attack and a follow-up click do
pickWeapon: the weapon picker is the strip's DOM (ui → ui)
setReckless: the Special bar's Reckless toggle writes the rider feature's effect
placeOpenDrawers: applyButtons' `after` re-places an open drawer whose button moved
tempHooks, opts: the one temporary-hook factory and the one hook-label helper (final review M7); never ctx or reg
